name: Scivr Demo
summary:
SCIVR is a comprehensive VR education platform designed to make learning more immersive, interactive, and engaging for students and individual learners. The app gives users access to a rich library of virtual reality learning experiences across STEM, career discovery, virtual expeditions, and biology dissections.
